content_kind: Controller-written English summary, not a verbatim reviewer transcript. Originals preserved in the local objective archive.
summary: Recommend own nominal nice!nano v2/nice!view reconstruction and licensed standard models. No complete redistributable manufacturer CAD was established.
findings: Official references establish nano identity, mid-mount USB and 3.2 mm overall height. Community v2 dimensions are 17.78 × 33.1 mm PCB and 34.624 mm overall length; package placement is inferred.
Exclude recolored Pro Micro and v1 holder models as exact v2 sources. Link photographs without relicensing them.
Use nominal nice!view 14 × 36 × 2.9 mm with a separate V-cut reserve; active image is 10.744 × 25.28 mm.
Reuse licensed KiSwitch/KiCad geometry with pinned provenance. Preserve selected 315/PCM12/TL3342 identities rather than substituting shop alternatives.
Do not reflect commercial modules. A narrower nano leaves only 0.09 mm overlap on old supports: verify positive support area and pad/socket clearance.
Keep the 7 versus 8.8 mm display connector mismatch and all physical fit limits open.
confidence: High in evidence and bounded approach; medium in unverified implementation, interoperability and inferred dimensions. No physical acceptance.
